note: The training data of the revision parts (records/revision.md) that no other file here lists: ids only, in training order. Equal to the runs' files named in each entry.

rl_relearn.selection: the pool after the pilot's 7,680 screened problems, in pool order, less the 52 problems an arm of the paper trained on (`skipped`, in pool order: all Nemotron's O arm; run_revision.py reads them), under the pilot's screen and keep rule (the base's one forced solution at top-p 1, kept if correct and uncapped); the first 640 kept. The screen of 1,536 problems is outputs/math_rft.csv.gz, run revision-rl-20260926.

rl_habit.selection: the base's forced response (top-p 1) to R5's prompts in R5's order, kept if its reasoning block closes, an answer follows, and it ends within the cap and the 17,000-token training length; the first 650 prompts give the 640 kept

rs_no_robots.source: no_robots_ids.json's source and selection rule, in the namespace of d3_instruction_tuning (its first 640); runs/math/revision-rs-20260926/examples.json
rs_no_robots.selection: the first 267 x 32 rows: one pass at batch 32 over the 8,545 that qualify, one left over

sh_sharp.selection: O's 4,480 problems in O's training order (the pilot's O arm), each with the base's first correct and uncapped forced solution at temperature 0.5 (top-p 1) within 4 draws; the problems without one drop out, and training fills their slots by cycling from the start

sd_s2.selection: the first 579 of the pilot's O problems outside D's and D2's, in SHA-256 order of 'revision-sd-s2:subset:<task_id>', then in the order of 'revision-sd-s2:D:<task_id>': D's problems in D's training order (P visits them in the same order). The rule pins O's order, 'revision-sd-s2:O:<task_id>' over the pilot's 4,480, and so it is not listed. Not pinned by the rule: the LoRA initialization seed, and P's texts, the base's own samples (runs/math/revision-sd-20260926/s2/p_samples.jsonl, in the external release). Drawn independently of s3's: the two share 91 problems.

sd_s3.selection: the first 579 of the pilot's O problems outside D's and D2's, in SHA-256 order of 'revision-sd-s3:subset:<task_id>', then in the order of 'revision-sd-s3:D:<task_id>': D's problems in D's training order (P visits them in the same order). The rule pins O's order, 'revision-sd-s3:O:<task_id>' over the pilot's 4,480, and so it is not listed. Not pinned by the rule: the LoRA initialization seed, and P's texts, the base's own samples (runs/math/revision-sd-20260926/s3/p_samples.jsonl, in the external release). Drawn independently of s2's: the two share 91 problems.
